revisions.goal: Polish the macOS eve approval UI so it closes automatically when the last plan is resolved, uses a compact empty popover, and uses lowercase eve branding.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- After approving or rejecting the final pending plan, the approval window/popup closes automatically instead of staying open empty.
- When the menu bar UI is manually opened with no waiting plans, the empty state uses a smaller compact window/popover size.
- Visible product copy uses lowercase `eve` instead of uppercase `EVE` in the macOS approval app.
- Existing multiple-plan queue behavior remains intact.

milestones.title: Inspect approval window lifecycle
milestones.goal: Find how the SwiftUI app tracks pending plans, window visibility, and empty state sizing.

milestones.title: Implement UI polish
milestones.goal: Close the popup after final resolution, compact empty state, and lowercase visible eve copy.

milestones.title: Verify and record
milestones.goal: Run Swift/Xcode checks, commit implementation, record EVE snapshot, and commit generated .eve record.
